assign.title: Session page: a session shows its tasks, live

complete.outcome: Branch task/session-page-tasks, worktree C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-4 (http://qf-4.localhost/), commits 3360dbe6e and f770cca66, not merged. Cause: StoreFolder.route sent any folder holding session.jsonl to AITask, which reads task.jsonl and so drew an empty column. Fix: new ai/AISession/StoreSession.js (extends StoreFolder) handles folders whose session.jsonl line 1 is {session:…}. It draws core/Session/SessionTasks (the existing task list) with the session completion on top, and replays the log live. Spawned-agent folders (line 1 assign) still open as AITask. Two Task bugs found and fixed on the way: a subtask added with no type was a bare Item (no state or verbs), and one line carrying start plus complete applied only start. Proof: the voice folder at 1200 and 400 shows the completed task, the process with Questions, Scout and Synthesize, and the completion line; the e00f55c9 tab session lists its 101 tasks (3 complete, 8 waiting); Task and Session tests pass (54/54, 7/7). Live: with the page open in headless Playwright I appended a task line to session.jsonl and the row appeared after 117 ms. I appended with a file append, not the item tool, because the item tool writes to the main tree. Shots: public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/process-system/session-page-tasks/shots/ (after-voice-1200, voice-400, tab-1200, tab-400, live-before, live-after). No before shot, since the page was empty. Readmes made out of date: ai/AISession/readme.md (add StoreSession), core/Session readme. The voice test folder was copied into the worktree for testing and is not committed.
